office: the National Identification and Registration Authority (NIRA)
note: The Jamaica Information Service: the national ID card is free to citizens. The minister responsible, as the Jamaica Observer reported (August 2022): renewed every 10 years for adults and every five for children, who may get it from birth; 18 is kept as the line between them. The time isn't stated.

sources.title: Jamaica Information Service, National ID Card Unveiled
sources.said: The card, which is to be provided free of cost to citizens under the soon to be rolled out National Identification System (NIDS)

sources.title: Jamaica Observer, Floyd Green talks NIDS with Manchester stakeholders (26 August 2022)
sources.said: Under the upcoming National Identification System (NIDS), there will be a renewal period of every 10 years for adults and five years for children who get their cards at birth.
